jobs.occupation: Experienced Consultant for Enterprise Cost Steering Team
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**_Are you ready to play a key role in transforming resource allocation at one of the leading financial institutions? Join our Enterprise Cost Steering team to lead initiatives that improve financial health through strategic cost optimization. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence cost efficiency strategies Group-wide.

_**What You Will Be Doing

**As an Experienced Consultant in Enterprise Cost Steering, you will support the executive leadership team with insights and recommendations to optimize cost structures. Working closely with Finance teams, Procurement, Support functions, and Business Units, you will identify cost-optimizing opportunities and implement best practices that strengthen our financial foundation.

• Own, drive, coordinate and execute end-to-end cost efficiency initiatives across the Group, including planning, tracking progress and managing delivery against agreed milestones

• Apply strong critical thinking by questioning assumptions and provide well-reasoned recommendations

• Leverage data analytics to conduct comprehensive cost analysis and identify cost efficiency opportunities

• Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to design and implement cost steering frameworks, ensuring clear governance, roles and responsibilities

• Translate complex data into actionable insights for senior leadership

• Act as trusted partner providing expert guidance on strategic cost initiatives

• Build and maintain dashboards and tools to support ongoing cost analysis, generating actionable insights, reporting and decision-making

• Facilitate workshops to align stakeholders and build consensus on initiatives and drive agreed actions to completion

**About You

**

• Strong consulting and project management background, with experience delivering strategic solutions in complex organisations

• Solid experience in enterprise-level cost steering or strategic cost management

• Excellent problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail

• Proven ability to independently manage initiatives from ideation through execution, including defining scope, plans, milestones, dependencies and delivery risks

• Strong critical thinking skills with ability to challenge assumptions

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to engage, influence and build trust across all levels while maintaining alignment, accountability and momentum

• Advanced skills in data analysis, reporting and visualisation tools

• Master's degree in finance, economics, business administration or similar

You thrive in dynamic environments with evolving priorities and demonstrate collaborative teamwork alongside quantitative expertise to support strategic decision-making.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a supportive team that values collaboration and professional growth. We offer hybrid working with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote knowledge sharing and culture building. You will have opportunities to develop your expertise while making meaningful contributions to our financial health and cost efficiency initiatives.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would love to hear from you if this opportunity excites you. Please reach out to Hadis Atighi at kho@danskebank.dk for any questions about the role. We process applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply sooner rather than later.

We look forward to receiving your application!

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our High-Performance Development team in Denmark in a role focused on Improving and maintaining our power plant control software solution that is deployed to SGRE wind farms all over the world.

Your day may start with investigating a support case, perform remote troubleshooting and conduct detailed event analysis of power plant operations to identify and resolve software or configuration issues.

Afterwards you would resume to your regular software development task in the agile development team, with daily scrums and develop high-quality code including unit- and automated integration tests to ensure correct behavior.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Develop/maintain. C# .NET based platform that supports real-time control

• Design and develop data services that serve, process and store large data amounts within wind farms.

• Relentless focus on cyber solutions.

• Develop configuration validation, monitoring and tooling

• Clarify and mature requirements

• Contribute to planning

What You Bring

• Bachelors or Masters degree in Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, preferably combined with relevant professional engineering experience.

• C# and automated testing.  Experience with CI/CD practices, agile development methodologies, C++ and Python language experience is appreciated as well.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, cybersecurity principles, and secure system integration, including areas such as PKI certificates, authentication mechanisms, secure communication interfaces, or IEC 62443-based environments.

About the Team

You will join the Development team in Denmark, where Software Developer/Engineers collaborate to constantly improve wind farm control and power plant solutions.

Knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and open collaboration are an integral part of the team's way of working. While the role offers a high degree of ownership and independent responsibility, you will be supported by experienced colleagues who work together to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver trusted measurement solutions.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Competitive compensation package

• Work-life balance: Flexible working time

• Flexible mobile working policy (hybrid)

• Local benefits such as meal allowance, flexible plan and much more

• Self-driven development framework with insights and resources to develop and grow on technical and soft skills. Continuous learning

• International and cross Business Units

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

**Do you want to lead project excellence across some of the largest and most complex infrastructure projects in Denmark? Are you an experienced project leader with a commercial mindset? Can you inspire and develop experienced project managers while improving project and portfolio performance? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

****Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**To further strengthen our project leadership and support the development of Transportation in Denmark, we are looking for a Vice President, Head of Projects. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of approximately 15 experienced multidisciplinary project managers, while taking direct responsibility for selected strategic projects. You will also have portfolio responsibility for medium-sized and smaller projects led by project managers across the organisation. You will report to the Senior Vice President, Transportation, in Denmark.

You will play a central role in connecting project delivery, portfolio performance, and strategic priorities. The portfolio comprises approximately 350 projects, from large multidisciplinary projects to smaller single-discipline assignments across key transportation disciplines. As a member of the Transportation leadership team, you will contribute to the strategic and operational development of the business.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Lead and develop a team of multidisciplinary project managers, ensuring clear priorities and high-quality delivery across the portfolio.

• Act as project manager on selected strategic projects, with responsibility for scope, schedule, risk, commercial performance, and client satisfaction.

• Oversee and develop a portfolio of approximately 350 projects, ensuring governance, resource allocation, risk management, financial control, and profitable delivery.

• Improve commercial performance by identifying risks and opportunities early, leading contract and client negotiations, and balancing quality, customer value, and profitability.

• Advance project management excellence across Transportation by developing ways of working and promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing across projects and disciplines.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is your ability to combine strong project management expertise with commercial understanding, stakeholder engagement, and people leadership. You thrive in complex environments where collaboration, cross-team coordination, and professional credibility are essential. You are committed to developing project managers, strengthening project delivery, and creating long-term value for our customers.

On top of that, you will have:

• A degree in civil engineering or other relevant education.

• Extensive project management experience from large multidisciplinary infrastructure projects in Denmark.

• A commercial mindset and solid understanding of portfolio performance, contracts, negotiations, risk, client relations, and financial results.

• Experience developing project management competences and ways of working across teams or portfolios.

• Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Work location

**The position is based in Lyngby or Aarhus, Denmark, with regular travel across our offices.

**Want to know more?

**Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Description

Exciting opportunity to join our Integrated & Global Services (IGS) line of business as an Associate Manager of Global Employee Benefits, based in our Nærum office, just outside of Copenhagen, Denmark. We offer an attractive workplace with a balanced mix of office and remote working. This role will be focused on managing and delivering large, strategic client engagements to multinational clients concerning their health and risk benefits globally. There may be a need to travel as needed for client and internal business needs.

Operating in the global marketplace means multinational companies face a variety of different business, cultural, language and regulatory environments. Our IGS line of business helps these companies navigate the challenges of multi-country complexity based on context knowledge of trends and innovative multi-client solutions. In particular, we help multinational companies develop global/cross-border solutions that meet the needs of both local and headquarter management in the design, establishment, financing, operation, oversight and monitoring of their compensation and benefit programs around the world.  In doing so, we work closely with our local offices in other geographies, as well as subject matter experts in other segments.

Our Global Benefits Management (GBM) business has a particular focus around the coordination of insured employee benefits, and also has the breadth to consider other Benefits and Total Reward aspects as demanded by our clients. The GBM business is one of the fastest growing areas of our business with an expanding marketplace and exciting, evolving client needs. As an Associate Manager in our GBM delivery team, you will play a key part in this growth story, taking a lead role in delivering across multiple focus areas and geographies to some of our biggest multinational clients.

The Role

• Manage multiple client engagements.

• Contribute to client delivery teams, providing guidance and training to junior team members as needed, and take responsibility for client deliverables

• Operate on teams providing advice on global health, risk and other benefits.

• Engage with clients, building relationships and provide consistent, superior project delivery.

• Manage large International consulting client engagements:

• Coordinate teams and promote effective working

• Develop project plans for execution of large, global engagements

• Ensure project managers are maintaining team progress against goals

• Build relationships internally and collaborate effectively on cross-functional and cross-regional teams.

• Partnering with regional/ local Health & Benefits, International consultants and regional/local geography teams

• Contribute to relationships with internal and external sources to maximize the activity on key target accounts

Qualifications

What you’ll bring

• 3+ years of project management, client facing or consulting experience

• Employee benefits experience, preferably with health and risk benefits, Rewards or HR expertise (across multiple countries is a bonus)

• Fluent in English language (Fluency in a Scandinavian language is a bonus).

• Track record of success in managing client contact relationships, demonstrating ability to communicate clearly in a client-facing role

• Ability to work both on their own and with client teams, including virtual work teams with members in different geographic locations.

• Understanding of the nuances of working across borders, with different cultures and with multinational organizations,

• The ability to deal positively with change and comfort working in a global environment.

• Strong organizational abilities and flexibility to work in a fast-paced, performance driven environment managing multiple project priorities.

• Interest and aptitude in keeping abreast of latest developments in global compensation/benefits approaches and contributing to the development of new tools and approaches.

• The ability to use Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data, as well as a working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint

• Higher educational background, e.g., a master’s or BA degree from business or numeric from a university or Business School

• Ability to travel on as needed basis

Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidate.helpdesk@wtwco.com

jobs.employer_name: KU- SCIENCE - CHEM og MATH og NBI-HCØ
jobs.description:
Associate Professor of the History and Philosophy of Mathematics (Parttime, Fixed-Term, 3½ years)
 Department of Mathematical Sciences
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  The position is in the history and philosophy of mathematics, with particular emphasis on teaching the history of mathematics within the university’s mathematics programs. The position is primarily associated with teaching, developing, and coordinating courses in the history of mathematics at the undergraduate and graduate levels.

  Applicants must have documented research qualifications within the history of mathematics. Emphasis will be placed on scholarly contributions that combine historical scholarship with a strong understanding of mathematics and its development.

  Applicants are required to have university-level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies, and the ability to explain and reflect on their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training program for assistant professors is required.

  Particular emphasis will be placed on extensive experience teaching the history of mathematics at the university level, including integrating historical perspectives into core mathematics curricula. Experience in developing and coordinating courses in the history of mathematics for students with a mathematical background will be considered an essential qualification.

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management, such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare, and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and outreach qualifications of applicants, including the ability to attract external funding, will also be considered.

  To be qualified for an Associate Professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

  The successful applicant will be part of the Analysis and Quantum Section within the Department of Mathematical Sciences. The department offers an active academic environment and access to its academic networks, facilities, seminars, and teaching community. Further information on the Department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the position can be made to the Head of Department, Mogens Steffensen, at head-of-department@math.ku.dk.

  The position is open from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment
 The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  The position is limited until 31 August 2030.

  The average weekly working hours are approximately 11 hours per week.
 
 When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen

  The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers   The deadline for applications is 3 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +2.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held in January 2027
 Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0757/26-2E.

**Vice President, Head of Thickening

****Job Description

****Location

**Global

**Reports To

**Product Group Head – Separation

**Role Purpose

**The Head of Thickening role is accountable for the global business performance and growth of the Thickener product offerings across the entire product lifecycle, encompassing both Capital equipment and Upgrades & Rebuilds (U&R).

This role owns the global P&L, commercial strategy, market positioning, pricing strategy, and product roadmap. Responsible for driving aggressive volume growth while protecting and growing profitability targets by maximizing customer value and ensuring a seamless customer offering throughout the lifecycle of installed equipment.

Working across a complex matrix organization, the VP leads the commercialization of both new equipment, upgrades and rebuilds, partnering closely with Capital Sales, Regional Sales, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations and Services, to accelerate growth and create sustainable competitive advantage.

**Executive Profile

**The successful candidate must combine strong commercial leadership with a recognized understanding of thickening technologies and their application in minerals processing.

While supported by a team of product managers, application engineers, and technical experts, the Head of Thickening must possess sufficient technical depth and industry credibility to engage confidently with customers, challenge assumptions, evaluate product strategies, and make informed business decisions. The role requires an executive capable of driving business growth while serving as a trusted authority on the Thickener portfolio across both Capital equipment and lifecycle solutions.

**Key Responsibilities

****Business and P&L Leadership

**

• Own the global P&L for the Thickeners portfolio, including Revenue, Operating Income, Contribution Margin, market share, and profitability.

• Develop and execute the long-term business strategy and growth plan for both Capital and Upgrades & Rebuilds businesses.

• Deliver aggressive growth targets through expansion of equipment sales, modernization programs, and installed-base opportunities.

• Manage business performance through rigorous forecasting, pipeline reviews, financial analysis, and strategic planning.

• Lead and develop a global team of Product Managers, Product Engineers, Applications / Proposals, Technical sales, etc.

• Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer value, growth, and execution.

• Identify and develop new revenue streams, market opportunities, and business models that enhance lifecycle value creation.

**Commercial Leadership

**

• Define and implement global commercial strategies for Capital and U&R offerings.

• Lead the global sales growth agenda by partnering with Capital Sales teams, Regional Sales organizations, and key account leaders.

• Drive pipeline generation, conversion improvement, and sales excellence across all regions.

• Establish and govern global pricing strategies that optimize profitability while maintaining market competitiveness.

• Support major commercial negotiations and customer engagements for strategic opportunities.

• Monitor market dynamics, customer trends, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities and business risks.

**Upgrades & Rebuilds Growth

**

• Own the global strategy, growth, and profitability of the Upgrades & Rebuilds business within the Thickeners portfolio.

• Develop lifecycle offerings that increase customer productivity, sustainability, and equipment performance.

• Collaborate with regional commercial teams to identify modernization, expansion, and rebuild opportunities across the installed base.

• Establish standardized upgrade packages, retrofit solutions, and value propositions that are scalable globally.

• Drive alignment between global product strategy and regional commercial execution.

**Product and Portfolio Strategy

**

• Define the global product roadmap and lifecycle strategy for the Thickeners portfolio.

• Collaborate with Engineering to prioritize innovation investments and technology development.

• Lead market assessments to identify customer needs, emerging trends, and competitive opportunities.

• Ensure product offerings remain differentiated, profitable, and aligned with market requirements.

• Drive standardization, product optimization, digital offerings, and sustainable technology initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Leadership

**

• Lead and influence a highly matrixed global organization without relying solely on direct authority.

• Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Services, Finance, and Regional leadership teams to execute business objectives.

• Ensure alignment between commercial commitments, operational capabilities, and customer expectations.

• Support execution excellence throughout the order lifecycle to maximize customer satisfaction and long-term portfolio success.

**Candidate Profile

**The ideal candidate is a commercially driven business leader with deep experience in thickening technology and minerals processing. They have successfully managed a significant product line, business unit, or portfolio with responsibility for growth, profitability, and market strategy. They are equally comfortable discussing thickener performance and applications with customers and engineers as they are leading commercial negotiations, reviewing business performance, and driving strategic growth initiatives.

**Experience

**

• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience within mining, minerals processing, capital equipment, or industrial technology businesses.

• Significant experience with thickening technologies, dewatering solutions, or adjacent process equipment used in mineral processing operations.

• Demonstrated understanding of thickener applications, customer processes, operational challenges, product performance drivers, and aftermarket opportunities throughout the equipment lifecycle.

• Proven success leading a global business, product line, service line, or business unit with accountability for revenue growth and profitability.

• Strong commercial leadership experience, including business development, sales strategy, pricing, market expansion, and P&L ownership.

• Track record of driving growth across both capital equipment sales and aftermarket offerings such as upgrades, rebuilds, modernization programs, and lifecycle services.

• Experience working across highly matrixed global organizations and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Established credibility engaging with customers, engineering teams, technical specialists, and regional commercial organizations at a strategic level.

**Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent preferred.

**Core Competencies

**

• Commercial Leadership

• P&L Management

• Strategic Thinking

• Stakeholder Management

• People Leadership

• Thickening Technology Expertise

• Sales & Business Development

• Lifecycle Solutions Management

• Results orientation

FLSmidth is the leading supplier of engineering, equipment and service solutions to customers in the mining and minerals industries – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers

jobs.occupation: Solution Architect, EndoIntelligence Hardware, Global R&D
jobs.description:
**Do you want to help bring innovative medical solutions to life and improve patient care worldwide?

**Do you have a strong technical background within hardware development and experience designing solutions for complex products involving multiple technologies? Then this could be an exciting opportunity for you. Apply today and join us for a career #ForeverForward!

**Designing solutions for next-generation endoscopy systems

**At Ambu, we develop innovative endoscopy solutions used by healthcare professionals around the world. As part of the EndoIntelligence Solutions area in the Global R&D organization, you will work closely with colleagues across engineering, product management, operations, quality, and regulatory affairs to develop solutions that meet customer needs and business objectives.

As Hardware Solution Architect you will play a key role in defining and maturing hardware solutions for our endoscopy platforms. Working closely with systems engineers, project teams, engineering specialists, suppliers, and technology partners, you will help ensure solutions are technically robust, scalable, and aligned with overall system requirements.

Our teams work in a collaborative environment where open dialogue, technical curiosity, and cross-functional teamwork are key to solving complex challenges.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Participate in early-phase product development activities, including concept development, technology evaluations, and feasibility assessments.

• Guide the development and maturation of hardware solutions in collaboration with cross-functional development teams.

• Define and maintain solution architectures for new products and platform developments.

• Collaborate across mechanical, electronics, optics, manufacturing, and software disciplines to develop integrated system solutions.

• Support architectural trade-off discussions balancing performance, reliability, manufacturability, risk, and cost.

• Ensure solutions are aligned with system requirements, architectural principles, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with suppliers and technology partners on technical evaluations, component selection, and solution development.

• Contribute technical input to project planning and development activities.

• Maintain solution documentation and support architectural reviews.

• Support development and verification activities by helping resolve technical challenges and identifying potential risks.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we recognize that no candidate will match every qualification perfectly. You are, however, likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Hold a degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Engineering, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, or a related technical field.

• Have experience developing complex products involving multiple technologies and engineering disciplines.

• Have experience with technical solution design, system architecture, or product development.

• Have experience with medical devices or other regulated industries.

• Enjoy working across disciplines to solve technical challenges and drive alignment.

• Have experience collaborating with external suppliers, development partners, or technology providers.

• Possess strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Thrive in a collaborative and international environment.

English language proficiency, both written and spoken, is crucial for the role.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success, and by joining us you will become part of an international organization focused on developing innovative solutions that improve patient care worldwide.

We offer great opportunities for professional and personal development, a broad range of employee benefits, exciting technical challenges, and continuous learning throughout your career.

**Job Description

**SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE AUDIO ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

As our Audio Engineer, you'll explore new ways to improve the audio experience across SOUNDBOKS products by combining signal processing, system simulation, and engineering insight. Working closely with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams, you'll help shape the technologies behind our next generation of speakers.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

**Audio System Development

**

• Develop audio concepts and proof-of-concepts at a system level.

• Explore new approaches to improve audio performance across products.

• Collaborate with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams during concept development.

**Signal Processing & Simulation

**

• Perform advanced signal processing simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• Simulate the interaction between acoustics, amplifiers, electronics, and battery performance.

• Evaluate and develop signal processing algorithms to improve overall product audio performance.

**System Performance & Collaboration

**

• Work closely across the entire Product Development team in order to evolve and improve the audio performance across our future product portfolio.

• Apply signal processing methodologies to improve sound pressure, sound quality, and battery performance.

**Job Requirements

****In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

**

• You hold a BSc or higher in Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Acoustics, or a related engineering field.

• You've designed and simulated audio systems, ideally loudspeakers, and know your way around signal processing for audio.

• You're comfortable using simulations and measurements to test ideas, challenge assumptions, and make better engineering decisions.

• It’ll be considered a plus if you have experience working with loudspeaker design, transducers, enclosure design, or audio electronics.

• You get excited by solving difficult audio problems and finding smarter ways to improve performance.

• You're naturally curious, love experimenting, and enjoy digging into the details until things sound and work better.

• You take ownership of your work and enjoy bouncing ideas around with people who know more than you in their field.

• You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have.

DHL Global Forwarding (Denmark) is looking for an experienced Ocean Freight Operations Head

At DHL Global Forwarding, operational excellence is about more than moving shipments from one place to another. It is about delivering consistent quality, improving the way we work and ensuring that our customers can rely on us – every day, across countries and continents.

As our new Ocean Freight Operations Head, you will play a central role in developing and strengthening our ocean freight operations in Denmark. You will be responsible for driving operational performance, implementing global standards and ensuring that our processes, systems and ways of working support both customer expectations and business objectives.

Working closely with colleagues across the Danish organization, regional and global teams, you will translate strategies and improvement opportunities into practical solutions that create measurable results.

This is a role for someone who understands the realities of freight forwarding operations, enjoys developing people and processes, and has the ability to turn change into lasting improvements.

You will report to the Ocean Freight Head Denmark and work closely with the regional Ocean Freight Operations organization..

Your key responsibilities in the role will be to:

And from us, you can expect:

• the opportunity to influence operational performance, processes and ways of working.

• close collaboration with experienced colleagues across Denmark and our international network.

• a position in a global organization with extensive professional and personal development opportunities.

• a working environment where collaboration, responsibility and continuous improvement are valued.

• being part of THE logistics company for the world.

• pension, health insurance, internal development opportunities and more.

Workplace: DHL Global Forwarding, enten Hedegaardsvej 88, 2300 Copenhagen S eller Centerbakken 1, Vejle – and as part of the job, you will have some traveling, mostly domestically, but as well internationally.

jobs.occupation: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 20,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

We are looking for an experienced Principal Design System Engineer to help shape and drive the continued evolution of Lighthouse Design System, 3Shape’s design system across web, mobile, and on-premises software solutions.

You will be the first dedicated Design System engineer and will be overall responsible for defining the technical direction and development of Lighthouse Design System. In this role, you will combine technical leadership, hands-on engineering, and cross-functional collaboration. Together with other colleagues, you will build a scalable foundation that enables our product teams to efficiently deliver consistent, accessible, and high-quality experiences. To achieve this, you will be balancing technical solutions with stakeholder management – staying ambitious yet pragmatic with the product. Likewise, you will be fundamental in creating followership across the broader organization, in ensuring its implementation, adaptability and recognition.

Becoming our new colleague means becoming a 3Shaper. Here we work to improve treatment and diagnostics for dental patients. We do this by providing innovative 3D scanners and advanced software for dental professionals that improve dental care and patients’ lives worldwide.

Key responsibilities

• 
Champion continuous improvement in how we develop, drive and implement the Lighthouse Design System, ensuring high ambition yet pragmatic approach to the result.

• 
Creating followership, by enabling product teams to adopt, contribute to, and get value from the Lighthouse Design System.

• 
Raise the engineering bar across front-end teams, by establishing scalable engineering standards, patterns, and quality practices across web, mobile, and on-premise software solutions.

• 
Own and mature our internal component library - balancing scalability, usability, performance, and maintainability.

• 
Partner with Product Portfolio Strategy and the Design System UX Lead, to ensure technical robustness, business impact and end-user value.

• 
Mentor and coach engineers that contribute to the Lighthouse Design System along with staying hands-on during key technical initiatives.

What are we looking for?

• 
10+ years software engineering experience, with significant experience in design system management and front-end development having held a similar principal or staff-level engineering role.

• 
Proven ability to influence technical adoption and direction for Design System adoption in an organization with many technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• 
Strong experience with Angular / TypeScript and modern front-end engineering. If you have experience working with multiple architectural design patterns across multiple tech-stacks, it is considered a plus.

• 
Strong experience with building and maintaining component libraries, design systems, or platform-like products serving multiple teams and the ability to establish clear approaches for ownership boundaries, versioning, and backwards compatibility.

• 
Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to a strong engineering culture.

• 
Experience of working closely together with designers and product managers and navigating technical trade-offs across multiple stakeholders.

• 
Experience in applying AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and developer experience, while maintaining strong technical standards and human oversight.

• 
Experience with improving developer experience through tooling, automation, documentation, or processes. To improve the way teams, contribute to and adopt the design system.

• 
A pragmatic and hands-on approach, with a passion for building simple and scalable solutions to complex problems.

We offer

• 
A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and cooperative colleagues - we are more than 40 nationalities in our DK based office.

• 
An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• 
Breakfast every day, and a delicious, healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
We provide a great social work environment with many voluntary activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games and running to bicycle clubs.

• 
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

• 
A clear, shared purpose: Help improve dental patient care on a global scale.

Get in touch now!

Please do not hesitate to apply for this exciting opportunity at one of Denmark’s most successful and fastest growing high-tech companies, as applications will be processed continuously.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. jobs.occupation: Technical Engineer – Power Electronics & Energy Control
jobs.description:
**Location: Denmark / Croatia

**Do you want to work on projects that drive energy efficiency and support the global transition to sustainable solutions? Are you passionate about power electronics, converter systems, and advanced energy control? Then this opportunity at DEIF A/S might be the right fit for you.

DEIF is a global leader in power efficiency, delivering advanced control solutions that support the green transition. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we are on an ambitious growth journey, focusing on innovation, sustainability, and intelligent energy management.

**About The Role

**As an Technical Engineer, you will join our Integration Team. We develop customized solutions for power generation and energy management systems across Marine, Offshore, and land-based industries.

In this role, you will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to design and implement solutions, particularly within:

• Power electronics and converter-based systems

• Power Management Systems (PMS)

• Marine and Offshore applications

You will play an important role in delivering reliable, efficient, and tailor-made solutions that create value for our customers and organization.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Analyze customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions

• Develop and implement application software for energy control systems

• Contribute to Power Management System (PMS) solutions

• Specify, document, and test software to ensure high quality

• Collaborate with R&D, Sales, and Service teams across the organization

• Participate in commissioning and provide support during project execution

• Travel occasionally to execute and support projects and customers

**Your Background

**You are a technically strong and solution-oriented engineer who enjoys working hands-on while collaborating with others.

**We Expect That You Have

**

• A degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Power Electronics, or similar

• Experience or strong interest in power electronics and converters

• Experience with Power Management Systems (PMS)

• Experience from the Marine or Offshore industry is a strong advantage

• PLC programming skills (IEC 61131-3)

• Experience with CODESYS is preferred. Knowledge of programming in C and C++ is an additional advantage.

• Good English communication skills, both written and spoken

**What We Offer

**At DEIF, you will be part of a professional and collaborative environment where innovation and responsibility go hand in hand. We value initiative, knowledge sharing, and continuous development, and we support flexible ways of working.

You will have the opportunity to work with advanced technologies and contribute to solutions that make a real impact on the global energy transition.

**Interested?

**Send your application and CV as soon as possible via our website www.deif.com/careers . Be review applications on a continuous basis.

If you would like to learn more about the position, you are welcome to contact Damir Bajraktarevic on dba@deif.com or +45 2777 6762.

**Automation Engineer – VELUX A/S - Thyregod

****Step into a key role where you will help shape the future of manufacturing through automation, robotics, and smart production technologies. With your technical expertise and passion for creating reliable production solutions, you could be our next Automation Engineer in Thyregod.

****Meet your future team

**You will become part of the Project Engineering team in Thyregod, working closely with colleagues across engineering, production, maintenance, and external suppliers. The team is responsible for developing, implementing, and maturing production technologies that support efficient, stable, and safe manufacturing operations.

As our automation specialist, you will play a central role in automation-related projects and production development initiatives. You will work in an environment characterized by collaboration, knowledge sharing, mutual respect, and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.

**What We Offer

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence both new projects and the continuous development of our production facilities. You will apply your technical expertise while collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines and helping to bring innovative solutions into operation.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Act as the automation specialist in engineering projects and production development activities.

• Provide technical guidance and support to automation technicians, maintenance teams, and project stakeholders.

• Verify and approve machinery and equipment according to applicable requirements and specifications.

• Support the commissioning, qualification, and maturation of new technologies and production equipment.

• Develop, review, and optimize automation solutions, including programmable logic controller programming and robotic applications.

• Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests and Site Acceptance Tests to ensure successful implementation.

• Contribute to initiatives involving industrial connectivity, manufacturing information technology systems, cloud-based solutions, servers, and standardized machine control concepts where relevant.

• Drive continuous improvements that enhance productivity, quality, safety, and operational stability.

**What You Will Bring

**You combine strong technical capabilities with a practical and structured approach to problem-solving. You enjoy working across disciplines and are motivated by transforming technical requirements into dependable production solutions.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a degree in engineering, automation, electronics, or another relevant technical discipline, or possess equivalent technical qualifications.

• Have around 5-10 years of experience within industrial automation, robotics, or manufacturing technology.

• Bring solid experience in programmable logic controller programming, preferably with Siemens TIA Portal.

• Have experience with robotics; knowledge of KUKA and/or Fanuc is considered an advantage.

• Have participated in commissioning activities, Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests, and equipment qualification processes.

• Have experience with or interest in industrial connectivity, manufacturing information technology, cloud technologies, servers, and machine control standards.

• Communicate effectively in both Danish and English.

• Enjoy collaborating with diverse stakeholders and building strong working relationships across functions.

The position includes limited domestic and international travel, typically up to 20 days annually. Travel will primarily be within Europe.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect from our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees, and the planet through our foundations. With production companies and sales operations across the world, our products are widely available, and we are committed to creating better living environments through daylight and fresh air.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX, we believe in fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive, develop, and perform at their best. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking.

We recruit, hire, develop, and promote people based on skills, qualifications, and potential. We value diversity and inclusion because we know that different perspectives help us create better solutions, stronger teams, and a more innovative workplace.

Imagine a future where you safeguard the stability and resilience of operational technology systems that underpin offshore and onshore renewable energy generation.

We offer a workplace culture where you´ll arrange with your people leader when you can work from home and from the office.

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

You’ll play an important role in:

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range:

For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr81,720.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our benefits package:

For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

Pre-employment background check:

This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Imagine a future with Ørsted

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small.

About Ørsted

• We provide countries, companies, and communities with sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive energy solutions, including offshore and onshore wind, solar PV, and energy storage.

• Our vision is to create a world that runs entirely on green energy.

• We built the world’s first offshore wind farm, Vindeby in Denmark, in 1991, and completed the world’s largest, Hornsea 2 in the UK, in 2022.

An inclusive team

At Ørsted, we strive to be an inclusive workplace where you’re respected for who you are, valued for the unique perspectives you bring, and rewarded fairly for what you achieve. We want all employees to have the same opportunities for impact and growth, no matter their age, race, ethnicity, place of birth, gender, sexual orientation, or disability.

jobs.occupation: Maternity Cover - Associate Category Manager, Indirect Spend
jobs.description:
Are you a proactive and results-driven professional eager to make a significant impact in the green energy sector? Semco Maritime is offering a unique, temporary opportunity for an Associate Category Manager to join our team for a minimum of 12 months maternity cover.

**Your position

**As an Associate Category Manager for Indirect Spend you will play a pivotal role in leading category strategies across various sectors including facility management, professional services, travel, and more. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in negotiating and driving cost efficiencies while promoting sustainable practices within the supply chain.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your workplace will be located at our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, positioned at the heart of the Danish energy industry with stunning waterfront views. This is a full-time, temporary maternity cover for a minimum duration of 12 months.

**Your Tasks & Responsibilities

**As an Associate Category Manager, your primary responsibility will be to support our Group Support Functions, including HR, Marketing and IT, with strategic procurement and day-to-day purchasing activities. You will also manage indirect spend, with particular responsibility for facility management, including Travel.

• Group Support Functions: Partner with functions such as HR, Marketing and IT to understand their requirements and provide procurement support aligned with business needs.

• Contract Negotiation: Lead and support supplier negotiations to achieve competitive pricing and favourable terms and conditions.

• Purchase Order Management: Coordinate and issue purchase orders, follow up on invoice handling and help ensure compliance with the procurement-to-pay process.

• Cost Management: Maintain visibility of expenditure, support budget control and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve commercial value.

• Indirect Spend and Facility Management: Manage relevant indirect spend categories, including facility management services, and support effective supplier performance and service delivery.

• Group Travel: Manage the travel category across the Semco Group, including supplier relationships, commercial agreements, cost optimisation and stakeholder support.

**Your Profile & Qualifications

**We are looking for an outgoing and positive individual who is passionate about indirect spend and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to enhance your skills within the department.

• Minimum experience of 2 years in Strategic Procurement or a related commercial field, experience in indirect spend is advantageous but not required.

• Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills, capable of interacting effectively across diverse cultures and functions. Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively.

• Positive, proactive, and a team player with the autonomy to operate independently.

• Fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

**Welcome to Semco Maritime

**At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:

**Project Operations Manager

__

**Your role and tasks

**We are looking for a Project Manager to lead service, upgrade, retrofit and modification projects within automation and control systems delivered to energy sector process- or offshore industry. Finance & Operations Manager

Full-time | On-site in Søborg/Copenhagen | Visibuilt

Join Visibuilt as we take a fossil-free, fermentation-based binder from the lab to the market. We are looking for an experienced financial controller who would like to be the person keeping a growing climate-tech company financially sound, investor-ready and well organised – from the month-end close to the board pack.

Location: Søborg, Greater Copenhagen (on-site)

Start: 1 January 2027 (or as soon as possible)

Type: Full-time employment

Salary: Competitive and in line with the market, reflecting your experience and responsibilities

Reports to: CEO & Founder, Line Kloster Pedersen

Core focus: Financial control and reporting, operations, grants, board and shareholder administration, financial modelling and fundraising support

About Visibuilt

Visibuilt is building fossil-free alternatives for pavement materials. Our core technology, visiBINDER, is a 100% bio-based binder developed from mycelium and designed to reduce energy use and CO2 emissions in infrastructure materials. We are based at Alfa Laval Innovation House in Søborg, just outside Copenhagen.

The role

Visibuilt has grown from an early-stage startup into a company with institutional investors, an active board, several public grant projects and an R&D team whose decisions need solid numbers behind them. You will be our finance and administration function: the person who makes sure our numbers are accurate, on time and useful for decisions – and who owns the operational backbone of the company.

·       A broad role with real ownership. You will be our only finance person, so you plan and manage your own areas – including the operational processes that keep a growing team running – in close collaboration with the CEO, our CTO, our external accountant and payroll administration, auditors and lawyers.

·       Cash is king.  You will own the cashflow budget and rolling forecast, so we always know our runway and spot pinch points well before they arrive. With several grant projects running, customer project, and heavy R&D, this means keeping a close eye on when money actually lands compared with when we spend it.

·       You oversee the bookkeeping. Our external accountant handles the day-to-day entries. Your job is to monitor, quality-check and follow up on their work, and to turn it into reporting the CEO and board can rely on.

·       Real business impact. You get to understand our business and provide market analyses for business development and cost models for R&D.

Responsibilities

Financial control

·       Monitor and quality-check invoicing, payroll and bookkeeping carried out by our external accountant (e-conomic) and approve payments together with management.

Reporting, audit & annual accounts

·       Deliver monthly finance reporting, budget-vs-actual and runway forecasts for management and the board.

·       Take responsibility for the annual accounts and the audit process with our auditors, meeting investor deadlines.

Operations ownership

·       Look after our people operations: keep the employee handbook and policies up to date, and run holiday planning and time registration.

Grant management

·       Manage our public grant portfolio (e.g. EUDP): project budgets, timesheets, reimbursement claims and progress reporting.

·       Support new grant applications with budgets and co-financing plans.

Board, shareholders & governance

·       Act as board secretary: prepare board packs, take minutes and follow up on decisions.

·       Manage shareholder matters – shareholder register, warrant programmes, general meetings, investor reporting and filings with the Danish Business Authority – with support from our lawyers. You coordinate and execute a quarterly shareholder report with the CEO.

Support for business development and R&D

·       Build market analyses (market sizing, segments, pricing) that support the CEO’s commercial work.

·       Build cost models together with R&D and production, so technical choices are informed by unit economics.

Fundraising

·       Be responsible for the financial projections and scenario models used in fundraising and investor dialogues.

·       Maintain our data room and coordinate due diligence processes.

What we are looking for

·       Solid experience in finance – typically 8 years or more – including time as financial controller, finance manager or similar. Experience from audit also counts.

·       Experience with the full finance cycle: month-end close, management reporting, annual accounts and working with auditors.

·       Experience reviewing the work of an external accounting partner.

·       Strong Excel skills: you are comfortable building budgets, forecasts and cost models from scratch.

·       You can explain financial analysis clearly to non-finance colleagues, and you are open about your assumptions.

·       Professional English is required; Danish is strongly preferred.

Nice to have

·       Experience from a start-up, scale-up or SME where you covered a broad range of tasks.

·       Experience managing and reporting on public grants (e.g. Innovation Fund Denmark, EUDP, MUDP or Horizon Europe), including timesheets and reimbursement claims.

·       Fundraising experience: data rooms, due diligence and investor financial models.

·       Board secretary work, shareholder registers, general meetings and company filings.

·       Background from manufacturing, materials or construction – helpful for unit-cost models.

·       Comfortable using AI and automation to speed up routine finance work.

How you work

·       Reliable. You are on time and prepared – especially with investors, auditors and other external partners.

·       You follow through. You see tasks through to completion, and ask for input along the way when you need it.

·       You share your view openly. You raise questions and concerns in the room, and once a decision is made you support it fully.

·       You work in shared systems. Everything lives in the company’s systems and shared drive and you have an eye for making systems more efficient to save time.

·       You use AI with care. For speed – never as a replacement for analysis you have checked yourself.

What success looks like

·       Monthly reporting is delivered on time and of high quality.

·       The annual accounts and audit are completed on time and without surprises.

·       Grant reimbursements and reports are submitted on time, with no rework.

·       Our financial and cost models are up to date and actively used in R&D, business development and fundraising decisions.

·       The data room is kept due-diligence ready, and our operational processes simply work.

What you can expect from Visibuilt

Visibuilt offers the chance to shape the finance and operations of a climate-tech company at a defining stage, in a small, committed team where your work has direct impact.

·       A key role close to the CEO and the board, with real influence on how Visibuilt is run and scaled.

·       An attractive salary package incl. pension, and participation in our healthcare program.

·       A mission-driven company building bio-based alternatives for construction materials.

·       On-site collaboration in Søborg at Alfa Laval Innovation House.

·       Flexible working hours, so you can plan your work around the rest of your life.

·       Participation in our warrant program and 30 days of paid holiday each year.

Not ticking every box?

Many candidates only apply when they meet every single requirement.

If you recognise yourself in most of this role but not all of it, we would still very much like to hear from you.
